prompt_text: Who is answering the intake today?
plain_language_variant: Who will be answering questions today?
example_starters: I'm here with someone supporting me
help_text: This helps me phrase questions in a way that fits who is answering.

prompt_text: How would you like to do this intake?
plain_language_variant: What kind of input works best for you right now?
short_variant: How would you like to answer?

prompt_text: What kind of prompt style would feel best right now?
plain_language_variant: How would you like me to phrase things?
example_starters: A little warmer and more supportive
help_text: You can change this anytime during the intake.

prompt_text: Would you like prompts to be read aloud?
plain_language_variant: Do you want me to read questions out loud?
help_text: You can turn this on or off later.

prompt_text: What feels most important for us to understand about why you are doing this intake right now?
plain_language_variant: What feels important to share about why you are here right now?
short_variant: What feels most important to share right now?
example_starters: I want someone to understand what has been hard
help_text: You can answer in your own words, skip, or come back later.

prompt_text: Has anything changed recently that made this feel more important now?
plain_language_variant: Did something change recently that made this feel more important?

prompt_text: Would you like to say a little more about what feels most important right now?
plain_language_variant: Can you share a little more about that, if you want to?
short_variant: Would you like to say a little more?

prompt_text: What helps communication feel easier or clearer for you?
plain_language_variant: What helps people communicate with you in a way that works better?
short_variant: What helps communication work better for you?
example_starters: I need more time to answer
It helps when things are written down
help_text: This can include pacing, wording, speech, typing, or anything else that helps.

prompt_text: Are there any things that make communication harder, more tiring, or less comfortable?
plain_language_variant: Is there anything that makes communication harder for you?
help_text: You can mention wording, pace, environment, or anything else.

prompt_text: Is anyone supporting you with this intake today, or in day-to-day life in a way that feels important to mention?
plain_language_variant: Is there anyone helping with this intake or with daily support that you want us to know about?
short_variant: Is anyone supporting you in a way that feels important to mention?
example_starters: I'm doing this on my own
I have regular support in daily life

prompt_text: What has felt most difficult, stressful, or important lately?
plain_language_variant: What has been hardest or most important lately?
short_variant: What has felt most difficult lately?
example_starters: There have been changes that are hard to manage
help_text: You can answer in your own words.

prompt_text: Have there been any recent changes in routines, stress, health, support, or environment that feel connected to this?
plain_language_variant: Have any changes happened recently that seem connected to this?
short_variant: Have there been recent changes that feel connected?
help_text: You can say as much or as little as you want.

prompt_text: How are these experiences affecting daily life, energy, stress, or support needs right now?
plain_language_variant: How is this affecting day-to-day life right now?
short_variant: How is this affecting daily life right now?
example_starters: I need more support right now

prompt_text: If you'd like, can you share a little more about how this is affecting you or what support would help?
plain_language_variant: Would you like to say a little more about the impact or support you need?
short_variant: Would you like to say a little more about the impact?

prompt_text: Are there any health or background details that feel important to mention for context?
plain_language_variant: Is there any health or background information you want us to know?
short_variant: Any health or background details to mention?
example_starters: There are health details that matter
There are past experiences that matter
Nothing comes to mind right now
help_text: This is a placeholder question and may be revised after clinical review.

prompt_text: Are there any past assessments, supports, or services that feel important to include?
plain_language_variant: Is there any past assessment or support history you want us to know about?
short_variant: Any past assessments or supports to mention?
example_starters: I've used services or supports before
I'd rather skip this for now
help_text: You can keep this brief or skip it.

prompt_text: Would you like to review, edit, or add anything before finishing?
plain_language_variant: Do you want to change or add anything before we finish?
help_text: You can go back to any section.
